note: Village of Birchwood park on the neck between Big Birch and Little Birch lakes. Sites 25-35 line the Big Birch Lake shore and 1-22 the Little Birch Lake shore; sites 1-7, 16-18, 20-22 and 25-35 may tie up a private dock. Sites 1-7 take campers up to 32 ft; 8-15, 19, 23 and 24 take only tents and pop-ups. Sites are close together. --Claude
summary: Village page read: $45/day incl. electric and tax (weekly $250, monthly $690, seasonal $2,200), 40 sites, 35-ft cap (29 sites take a 23-ft rig), May 1-Sep 30, 30/50 A, showers, dump; reserve by form/text with a half deposit. Lakefront kept on imagery (dock sites 15-25 m from the water over open lawn). Name, nightly share flagged.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront kept. Zoom-19 Esri imagery: the Big Birch Lake row (sites 25-35, around 45.6624,-91.5499) sits 13-25 m from the shore over open lawn with private docks at most pads (a tree clump fronts the middle of the row, about sites 29-31); the Little Birch Lake row (sites 1-22, around 45.6614,-91.5505) is 14-25 m from the shoreline, mostly open grass with a few shore trees, the lake there fringed by a weed bed. The village lists 1-7, 16-18, 20-22 and 25-35 as able to 'accommodate private docks'. Whether those dock sites are sold by the night or mostly go to the $2,200 seasonals is not stated anywhere; the reservation form takes daily, weekly, monthly and seasonal requests alike.

NIGHTLY SHARE: not measurable - no site list or engine; the village sells daily ($45), weekly, monthly and seasonal (5-month) spots and a $250 winter storage for returning seasonals. Google 4.3 from 118 reviews; the newest reviews describe overnight and family camping ('Fun place to meet family and friends', a tent camper's 'it has 35 sites, a few campers were there'), no resident complaints. Not read as mostly seasonal.
FIT: 11 of 40 sites (8-15, 19, 23, 24) appear in neither the 32-ft nor the 35-ft list ('All 40 of our campsites can accommodate pop-up campers'), so a 23-ft motorhome fits 29 sites.
NAME: the entry says 'Doolittle County Park'; it is the Village of Birchwood's 'Doolittle Park' (not a county park). Ownership local is right.

PHONE 715-651-6015 is the park manager's text/call line on the village page (village hall 715-354-3300). Website live and current; Google links the old http://www.birchwoodvillagewi.com/doolittle-park, which redirects to the stored page.
PIN: stored 45.6617,-91.5512 is ~75 m from the middle of the two rows (~45.6619,-91.5503). Fine.
HOOKUPS: 30 A and 50 A and 'Water' listed among campground amenities; water at the site is not stated explicitly (stored derived water: true left).
